exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Must not do something".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～てはいけない matches "Must not do something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～てはいけない.
exercises.explanation: Expresses prohibition; indicates that an action is not allowed.
